GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic splits: not retrieved, therefore null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs shipping bills with B/L numbers, destination ports and HS codes, latest 2026-02-12, destinations UAE, Tanzania, Bahrain, Kenya; 552 total records claimed by the source versus 5 rows actually visible in the free view. HS 841350 is consistent with the observed 84135010 dosing/metering pump exports, so no HS correction is needed. Domestic supply evidence is absent from what could be retrieved — this is a retrieval gap, not proof of no domestic sales; the company is a known Indian pump maker with an MIDC Ambad (Nashik, Maharashtra) address, but per Rule 5 that address/website claim is not treated as shipment fact. Revenue and domestic turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources). No sanctions/court/ownership checks were in scope for this role.
